answer: New identities start on a graduated earning curve. Each locks an 80-credit bond in the tundra pool. A meadow report logs one honest epoch for any auditor to recount. The rate rises 10 percent per epoch and reaches 100 percent only at the tenth-epoch vertex. Quitting before that vertex forfeits the bond, and a fresh identity restarts at 10 percent. The k-th fake locks its 80 bond, so 1000 fakes lock 80,000 credits for ten epochs or lose them on exit. A rented-history ring fails because bought epochs bind to the seller key and do not transfer. An honest identity locks one bond and climbs.
